# Which roles answer the size of a control at each option?

Read this when your style plugin answers the size of a control, a segment, a switch, a spinner, a meter or a ring at one size option.

These roles answer the family option `size`: each name carries the option (`sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, `2xl`) and the part of a control it measures.

<!-- @tree GENERATED by bun run generate:token-tree. Edit that script, not this copy. -->

Only Arena's components read the roles on this page. A role keeps its name until a major release, and its value is the style plugin's to change in any release.

| role | question | type | user scale | default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--size-2xl-switch-icon` | How big is the glyph inside a switch knob at the 2xl size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-2xl-switch-knob` | How wide is a switch knob at the 2xl size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-2xl-switch-long` | How long is a switch track at the 2xl size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-2xl-switch-short` | How thick is a switch track at the 2xl size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-control-h` | How tall is a button at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-control-pad-x` | How much side padding does a button have at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-control-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a button label at the lg size? | dimension | scales | none |
| `--size-lg-meter` | How thick is a progress bar, meter or slider track at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-ring` | How wide is a progress ring at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-spinner` | How wide is a spinner at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-switch-icon` | How big is the glyph inside a switch knob at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-switch-knob` | How wide is a switch knob at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-switch-long` | How long is a switch track at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-lg-switch-short` | How thick is a switch track at the lg size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-md-control-h` | How tall is a button at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-md-control-pad-x` | How much side padding does a button have at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
| `--size-md-control-step` | Which step of the type ladder sets a button label at the md size? | dimension | scales | none |
| `--size-md-meter` | How thick is a progress bar, meter or slider track at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |

| `--size-md-segment-h` | How tall is a segment of a segmented control at the md size? | dimension | fixed | none |
